# Saim Dev — Custom Next.js Web Development, Headless Shopify & Zero-Commission Takeaway Systems

> We are web architects, engineering high-converting digital platforms. Specialized in bespoke web design, lead conversion, and performance optimization. Over the last seven years, our studio has engineered fast, modern, high-converting platforms for service leaders and ambitious brands across the UK, US, and Europe — dentists, mechanics, auto detailing studios, salons, contractors, private clinics, headless Shopify retailers, SaaS startups, and zero-commission takeaway operators. Together, we craft digital platforms designed to rank on Google, load almost instantly, and turn visitors into loyal, paying clients.
>
> Saim Dev is a bespoke web engineering studio specializing in custom business websites, high-converting landing pages, SEO-friendly Next.js 16 development, Core Web Vitals performance optimization, headless Shopify storefronts, zero-commission takeaway ordering systems, and AI-powered web solutions.

## What Makes Saim Dev Different (Our Unfair Advantage)

1. **Free Live Concept Preview Before You Pay**: Share your brief or existing site first; we engineer a live interactive homepage concept preview in the browser, and you only proceed with the 50% milestone deposit if you like the direction.
2. **Fixed Prices (From £250 / $300 USD) & £0 Monthly Retainer**: Transparent 50/50 milestone billing with zero recurring agency retainer lock-in.
3. **100% GitHub Repository & Source Code Ownership**: Upon completion you receive full custody of the clean Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript repository and cloud deployment.
4. **Free Public ROI & Compliance Utilities**: Includes our free [Takeaway Commission Savings Calculator](https://www.saimdev.site/tools/commission-savings-calculator) for takeaway owners auditing 28%–35% delivery app fees, plus 15+ inspectable live reference builds at [https://www.saimdev.site/demos](https://www.saimdev.site/demos).

## Core Technologies

- Next.js (App Router, React Server Components, Static & Edge Rendering)
- React 18/19 & TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS & GSAP Motion Architecture
- Shopify, Shopify Plus & Headless E-Commerce
- PostgreSQL, Supabase & Stripe Payment Integrations
- Edge Cloud Hosting (Vercel, Cloudflare)
- Structured Data (Schema.org JSON-LD, OpenGraph, Speakable AEO)
